answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, as a result paying the vertex bond on all of them and exposing each to the jetty slash. Because the relic audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 10 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Collateral of 85 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
